'''Jinatte the Merciless''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] living during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jinatte the Merciless was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as a World Boss for Dark vs. Light system. Whenever the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] reaches victory state on a server, Jinatte the Merciless has a chance to spawn at one or more of selected locations on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] alongside other Dark Side World Bosses. Though killing her is required for an in-game achievement, it is impossible to determine when her [[Death/Legends|death]] took place.
